reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: §19.2 gives a ninety-day Deliverable conformance warranty (spelled out, hence the regex miss) and hosted Services conformance for the full subscription term, meeting or exceeding the preferred period.

Remedy ladder in §19.4 (re-perform / repair / replace, then terminate and refund Fees paid) matches the playbook's repair-replace-refund requirement and is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy and indemnified claims.

Scope elements are present: professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel (§19.1), material conformity to documentation/specifications, plus malicious-code and Applicable Law warranties (§19.3); §19.5 disclaims only implied warranties and expressly does not limit express warranties, so there is no 'AS IS' swallow and no walk-away exposure.

Correctly no redline and no counterparty comment, consistent with compliant-finding handling; the 'ninety (90)' numeral point is properly recorded as internal housekeeping rather than raised as a negotiation item.
The single failed deterministic check is a phrasing artifact (numeral written as words) and does not undermine the substantive conclusion.
